limitations: Single instrumented request with unlocked clocks.
Phase split inferred from engine wall time and cuProfilerStart end; it is not an NVTX marker.
GPU idle time includes CPU work, scheduling, synchronization and dependencies; it is not all removable overhead.
Kernel and copy durations overlap. They must not be summed into request latency.
Retaining observed kernel durations while removing waiting is a conditional scenario, not a hardware roofline.
